title: GTA 5 SCRIPT UNIVERSAL SCRIPT OP
features:
GANG Menu is a Roblox Lua panel with a GTA-style animated interface (black/red theme, LuckiestGuy font, glow effects).

Key access system (GANG-FREE-LIFETIME) with auto-save in GANG_SAVE/save.json so you never have to retype it.

4 languages available at first launch: French, English, Spanish, German (remembered afterwards).

Keyboard navigation: M = open/close, ↑↓ = navigate, ←→ = modify, E/Enter = select, Backspace = back (keys are locked so your character doesn't move).

FUN menu: Godmode, Invisible, Noclip, RGB Skin, Click TP, Name Glitch, Infinite Jump, No Fall Damage, Anti-AFK, Ragdoll, Force x1000, RGB Crosshair.

PVP menu: Aimbot (locks head), AIM Scope (right-click), FOV Circle, ESP Box RGB, Skeleton ESP, Team Check, Autoclick, Anti Fling.

VISUAL menu: Headless, Korblox, Remove Accessories, Anti-Lag, Saturated Colors, Stretch Rez, FOV Lock, Player ESP, Tracer ESP, 24 sky themes, 14 animation packs, 3 outfits, Music Player (Roblox ID), Billboard.

RAGEBAIT menu: Spin, Spin 90°, Fake Lag TP, Fake Lag Angles, Glue (sticks to nearest player).

PRESETS menu: quick combos RGB / PVP / RAGEBAIT / FUN / ESP / Disable All, plus SETTINGS with "Join Discord" and "Reset save" buttons.

Head billboard: red "GANG" text, your username, and the discord.gg/r2NWKbNz2 link; key + language saved, 4 dynamic categories, panel positioned top-left (20px, 60px)
